pricing_basis: OpenRouter first-party OpenAI route list price; cache discounts and fallback routes excluded

threshold_selection.training_data: completed v1 Luna zero-shot probabilities from the other four issue folds only, matched to input mode
threshold_selection.transfer_rule: freeze the selected threshold before the v2 provider run and apply it unchanged to v2 probabilities in the held-out fold
threshold_selection.candidate_grid: all unique training-fold refusal probabilities plus 0 and 1
threshold_selection.eligible_rule: refusal precision >= 0.75 and recall >= 0.80 on the four training folds
threshold_selection.selection_rule: among eligible thresholds maximize refusal F1, then precision, then choose the higher threshold
threshold_selection.failure_rule: if none is eligible, among thresholds with recall >= 0.80 maximize precision, then F1, then choose the higher threshold; if no threshold reaches 0.80 recall, maximize recall, then precision, then F1, then choose the lower threshold; a training-fold failure is recorded but final promotion still uses the untouched concatenated predictions
